tb21_profile.skill: Build a Python package with Cython/C extensions from source and fix NumPy 2.x incompatibilities (removed/renamed C-API, PyObject* vs PyArrayObject* casts, deprecated aliases), patch setup.py/.pyx/C so build_ext succeeds, install into the global env, and make the shipped tests and the README example import and run.
tb21_profile.domain: Python packaging / build toolchain (setup.py, build_ext, pip install from source); Cython and the NumPy C-API; a scientific package (pyknotid) with .pyx extensions.
tb21_profile.task_form: build/packaging + fix-a-compatibility-break: get a from-source native build to compile, install, and pass its test suite on an incompatible dependency version.

verifier_notes: No grade I relied on was wrong. In Terminal-Lego/TW I avoided tw_677182 (build a wheel) because it is FREE; I used tw_129867 and tw_108330 instead. notes: This is the best-covered of my five tasks and CalibForge is overwhelmingly the strongest corpus: it holds 6 of the final 10, including two 5/5/5 twins - debugging_20260606_172554_001 (build fitsio from source against NumPy 2.3.0, fix the NumPy-2.0 C-API pointer-cast errors, pass tests) and software-engineering_20260513_204536_002 (Cython builds on numpy1 but fails on numpy2). CalibForge has a whole cluster of 'build this Cython/C extension from source and pass tests' tasks, all graded strong, which is exactly the corpus note's promised Cython coverage; it beats the v1 pool decisively here. TMax is a strong second (its numpy-include-dir and vendored-C-extension-build tasks are near-perfect and take three final slots). SWE-Rebench is unexpectedly useful: pypa/setuptools issues about building an Extension, pyccel (Python->C/Fortran compiler over numpy arrays), h5py (Cython) and an explicit numpy-2 bug give it real skill/domain transfer despite the issue-fix task_form, so it earns one final slot. SWE-Smith is the weakest graded corpus for this task - its best is conan (a C/C++ build-system/compiler-flags manager), decent on domain but no Cython/numpy and pure bug-fix form; note conan-io__conan...combine_module__ib9j050b at rank 10 is a deliberately-labeled low-transfer placeholder. Terminal-Lego's real contribution is R-package-from-source build-dependency fixes (missing pcre.h/libcurl/JNI headers) - genuinely the same 'satisfy the native build dependency then recompile' skill, just in R. Recursive-Task-Synthesis ships NO verifier (all absent) and has no Cython/numpy task; its build-from-source chores (PostgreSQL tarball, CMake builds, Go .so) are honest task_form matches but were kept out of final in favor of graded equivalents. Downstream: if only one corpus can be drawn on for this TB2.1 task, CalibForge alone supplies four or five 4-5 finalists.
